call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here, I can hear you. Go ahead.

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I'll have to think about it.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh, wait, I have one more question.

call.speech.no_wait.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: only the polite (vykání) 'počkejte' is listed, but call.json allows tykání with friends, so the AI could say 'počkej' unchecked. Meaning should be: banned stalling phrases in both forms; add 'počkej', 'chvíli', 'sekundu'. | Translator note: List of banned stalling phrases, Czech.

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you called is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Ah, a package? Sure, please leave it in front of the door, thank you very much. / OK, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: goodbye, goodbye (phone), bye, have a nice time, take care, take care (informal), have a nice day, have a nice rest of the day. Wrap-ups: that's all, I won't keep you, I have to finish, we'll call each other later. Ends: Thank you for your help, goodbye. / OK then, that's all, take care. / I've noted everything, thank you, have a nice day. Not ends: Good day, this is Novak from the bank, calling about an offer. / The courier didn't say goodbye yesterday and drove off, can you look into it? / Watch out for fraudulent messages, which I now want to tell you more about. / I won't keep you long, I just need to verify two items.
call.speech.closing.note: AI check: not_ends #1 ('Dobrý den, tady Novák z banky...') has no farewell word, so it does not test the rule; the other three do. | Translator note: Farewells and examples need a native check before verified can be true.

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system judged it to be a sales / scam call, so the AI deliberately stalled the caller so he would waste his time

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said it was an urgent matter: the phone called the owner, they picked up and were connected to the caller, the AI left the call; the call was not treated as a sales or scam call to be stalled

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said it was an urgent matter and the owner was alerted immediately; the call was not treated as a sales or scam call to be stalled, so the task is to call them back as soon as possible

notify.n_fit_unsupported.back: This phone cannot transmit the AI's voice into calls.

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini decide when the caller has finished speaking

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks another language, the AI switches to it.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Deliveries: please leave the parcel at reception.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds a quiet room noise behind the AI's voice, so it sounds as if a real person picked up the phone.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when the caller is obviously selling something or trying a scam.

console.f_stall.back: Keep them stalling with the call

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI pretends interest and asks about details so they waste time. It reveals nothing and agrees to nothing. Off: it declines and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Longer calls use more of your Gemini limit.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = the same model as for normal calls.

e.g. Parcels: leave at reception.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: fill in the Webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy webhook URL) or the bot token with the channel ID; one is enough. For private messages enter your own ID instead of the channel ID. Commands from chat: fill in the bot token and channel ID and turn on Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy the Incoming Webhook URL (also applies to Mattermost) or fill in the bot token with the channel ID; one is enough. Commands from chat (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode and fill in the bot token (xoxb-), the app token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: generate the channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). First add the bot to your friends. The LINE Notify service was shut down in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. For ntfy.sh leave the server empty. A token is needed only for protected topics.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on the iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. For the public server leave the server field empty.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application at pushover.net and get the API token. You find your user key on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot and copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → add a custom bot and copy the webhook URL. If you chose "Sign" as the security, paste the secret key (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot and copy the webhook URL. Do not turn on signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan website.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), the access token of the sending account and the ID of the room the account has joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google Account → Security → 2-step verification → App passwords). Not your usual password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which services receive the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL accepting a JSON POST with the fields event, title, body and data. Suitable for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the menu … at the channel → Workflows → "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", finish the steps and copy the resulting URL. The old Office 365 connectors are discontinued.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps and integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook and copy its URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: turn it on, choose the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter its email and API key as email:key. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or emails for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or enter a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Address of your Nextcloud, user name and an app password (Settings → Security) in the form user:password, and the conversation token (the last part of the link to the conversation).

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming webhooks → Create and copy the webhook URL. On your own network you avoid certificate errors by using an http:// address on port 5000.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the target empty to send to all devices, or enter a device ID or an email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. A group code sends the message to the group; an empty field only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. For the public server leave the server field empty.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Simplest: a simple push token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website without a target. Or the app's appToken (AT_…) with user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app create a token for this sender and copy it. For the public server leave the server field empty.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login name is also the sender. If the provider offers an app password, use it.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Address of your Home Assistant, a long-lived access token (Profile → Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (you find it in Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: At ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation you find your key. Create an applet "If Webhooks: Receive a web request" with the same event name; value1 is the heading and value2 the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications use this address. Empty = the address shown in grey; when using Docker or for access from outside, enter your own.

console.use_this_url.back: Use the address of this page: {url}

console.g_summary_d.back: After each call the AI writes a short summary. There is usually nothing to set up here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any service compatible with OpenAI works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: By default it uses your Gemini key. To use another service, choose "Another service".

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date is agreed in the call (a delivery, an appointment), the summary will contain an "Add to calendar" link.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to arrange a time, the AI does not agree right away; it says it will check and let them know. You then tap Accept or Decline in the "Task" section on the Calls page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After your decision, the phone that took the call sends the caller a text message (only to mobile numbers). Off: the AI calls them back instead.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: a text message to a mobile, an AI return call to a landline. Hidden numbers and numbers that cannot be called back (abroad, toll-free lines etc.) get no reply.

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models with the word "thinking" in the name. Low answers fastest.

or: Ask which day at the weekend, Saturday or Sunday, suits him for dinner
